overall: As of 01:45 ET, Los Angeles is sitting at 64.4°F with zero warming velocity, consistent with a classic early-July marine layer pattern — patchy fog, elevated dewpoint (57°F), and steady SW onshore flow at ~9 mph. No warming trend is evident overnight, which is expected; the day's heating will depend entirely on how well the fog burns off before the afternoon peak near 14-16h local time.
